chunks: They only want that you should relent, so that they may come to terms.

key_terms.فَيُدْهِنُونَ: So they will incline or follow suit

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the Quran says 'They wish you would incline'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Qalam is often linked to the Banu Nadir or the hypocrites who urged the Prophet to moderate his stance to secure their political alliance, reflecting the concept of *Istidraj* or gradual enticement. It underscores the strategic patience required of the Imam, who must remain firm in truth even when pressured by those seeking a convenient compromise to maintain their own status.
